texts.text0_1: Why isn't the Outland called Draenor anymore?
texts.text1_1: Is the Twisting Nether shaped like a pretzel?  And just what is a Nether?  The orphan matron said I shouldn't ask people about their nethers.
texts.text3_1: If I hold my breath, what color would I turn?
texts.text4_1: If a horse gets horseshoes, will I get draenei shoes?
texts.text5_1: If the Burning Legion is such a problem, why not just throw water on them?  Then they'll just be a Legion.
texts.text6_1: How do you drink and eat so much, and not get fat?
texts.text7_1: Does a naaru turn off the Light when it wants to sleep?

ad0535e1696c25bfc0429268db22c401e0866a6e.LogDescription: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
ad0535e1696c25bfc0429268db22c401e0866a6e.QuestDescription: My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises.  Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in Dun Morogh!$B$BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides.  The Yeti are native to Feralas, with many found in Feral Scar Vale.  I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten.  If that sounds fair to you, then we're in business.

ad0561c70491adcc8e7c91f0213478dbdd37fb1b.comment: Argus Shadow Mage - In Combat CMC - Cast 'Shadow Bolt' (Phase 1)

ad0568450b20e076bcdb9a7e903568cfedc7d5ed.LogDescription: Speak with Assistant Klatu, at Honor Hold's inn.
ad0568450b20e076bcdb9a7e903568cfedc7d5ed.QuestDescription: $n, while you were on your mission in Zeth'Gor, I received news of my commanding officer, Colonel Jules.  He was stricken with a demonic corruption while fighting near the Gor'gaz Outpost, and his situation has grown very bad.$B$BYou have made such great gains for us against the fel orcs.  Your strength in battle is without question... is your spirit just as strong?$B$BPlease, return to Honor Hold and speak with Klatu, in an upper room at the Honor Hold inn.

ad086879f601bf6258091f0e26353c5af9e07b4d.Text: My banishment is ended! Let the blood flow!

ad0888e39d2f0d9e2ca3de4567010c1af8e05ca5.Text: We are born into a perilous age, where the forces of darkness are determined to bring about our destruction.

ad09b7808a3c8cca8c063b1bdcd222baf28929da.Text: Please speak with Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale, she will see to it that you are properly rewarded for your bravery this day.

ad0b3b752a894aee72546c12794bc2b71e34eb86.Text: Words cannot express my gratitude, $n. Thank you for your kindness.

ad0b94ba2d422f37206bdf04b446c5bdc322f275.RewardText: Well done.$B$BI will dispose of these filthy garments by cleansing them in the moonwell and destroying them through the power of the goddess!

ad0dbe9e53dcd779a0f32311e62d2f12b899e8b1.Text: A skunk, rabbit, and a fawn travelling together. Now thats something you don't see every day. No matter, i'll be dining on venison tonight!

ad1201872e62879e9e36969aaa6fa93da210eaa6.LogDescription: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Avareth Swiftstrike at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
ad1201872e62879e9e36969aaa6fa93da210eaa6.QuestDescription: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, speak with Rugan Steelbelly. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Rugan will tell you how to use this powerful ability and teach you some basic strategies.

ad13ec73b15cced2b40ce38455fbbecd6b308f40.Text: Here's a little somethin' extra since I'll be away.

ad18ea92499ebae1974ce90517b7490bdf77aa47.Text: The Sunreavers are proud to present their representatives in this trial by combat.

ad1adccd355630490f5f62921bd28048cb02c5b4.RewardText: You do some good killings over there. I see vrykul men fall and get stabbed with Sylvanas flag. Our side doing good!

ad2076a555574b363c11cc0a95002edc0410c2cf.Text: Thrall will remain a slave. Taretha will die. You have failed.

ad2460bd1bee330d386f688ccfabce41c2d9d7b5.comment: Mudsnout Shaman - In Combat CMC - Cast 'Lightning Bolt'

ad283382de524b158135be68c0341a51464e91d3.Text: I've never understood your type. The hero...

ad2a9b21263dc91ba1c0eeec40bab61c2dc84dbf.Text: Leave this accursed place at once!

ad2fd3b85c323589a3cb7302582633fd4e6ed43f.comment: Living Decay - Between 40-80% Health - Cast '11442' (No Repeat)

ad346e3a3180321bf33349b80078d76a40079a0c.LogDescription: Recover Sha'ni's Nose-Ring from Krom'Grul and return it to Thal'trak in Kargath. Search the various caves and mines in Dreadmaul Rock.$B
ad346e3a3180321bf33349b80078d76a40079a0c.QuestDescription: My whole platoon was captured, $N. All were slain - except me.$B$BTheir leader, Krom'Grul, wanted to save me for some sort of ritual.$B$BI was chained to this altar and brutalized by the beast. My physical being ceased functioning after an hour of this torture. The beast then ripped my wedding nose-ring off of my face and stuck it on his finger. I had never seen such savagery!$B$BFind Krom'Grul and kill him! Take my ring back to Thal'trak.$B$BAnd $N, tell him that we will meet again... in another life.

ad39b1250d8ce0a1836fbf3c9be4694f80f3a6a5.OptionText: I want to create a guild crest.

ad3d9673bd25a99bbd40aa13fa839d1ac3c3c2e1.comment: Southsea Brigand - In Combat - Cast 'Backhand' (No Repeat)

ad48a3bec4e11215e4a7557c3425cc92a8b3af36.comment: Frostpaw Trapper - In Combat - Cast 'Aimed Shot'

ad4af0c4cd214bf1d496c52eb5a0bf4ea30397b2.comment: Ancient Stone Keeper - In Combat - Cast Sand Storm

ad4cc3d5794b9c1c9111fdc89884e046d4ca94ed.comment: Champion Irondeep Guard - In Combat - Cast 'Mortal Strike' (Phase 1) (No Repeat) (Normal Dungeon)

ad4da37766ab170748d3a09291386248b84dfc6f.RewardText: You have done what none thought was possible and brought back our missing brothers and sisters. You are a hero to the Mag'har, $N. All will know your name and the deeds that you have performed for us.

ad4df18c582ea740ce5564e3f68eec6975c3fd27.LogDescription: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters and 8 Witch Doctors, and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
ad4df18c582ea740ce5564e3f68eec6975c3fd27.QuestDescription: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here. $B$BThe trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.$B$BWe start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.

ad4f229061c455d18a19e8552dda37df9876aaf1.comment: Northspring Roguefeather - Between 10-50% Health - Cast '11014' (No Repeat)

ad4f9836a0131ed0311ecceeb6bbd40818c18f5e.comment: Cavern Shambler - In Combat - Cast Knockdown

ad50faf05b9ab2e6cdf80f6032942fbeead31b12.Text: The worg growls as it closes in on its prey.

ad518752fd3c4bd19e6f9f24b46ea393ad8c410e.CompletionText: An Invader's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops.  These are sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in the Plaguelands.  Slaying such a creature is indeed a challenge, but one that should be relished with a commission to vanquish evil.$B$BThe Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for ten of these insignia.  Bring them to me here, and I will make sure you receive your just reward.

ad5292485e500b7434e5d84ccc62fed4d6cab7f8.Text: I will break you... as I broke him!

ad5b24a19fd763cc41dccdebb6ed22ccd9b52209.RewardText: Do not fear, $N. While you are here we will speak using our minds.$B$BI am grateful to Farseer Nobundo for sending you to me. There is a great disturbance that is polluting the waters on and around Bloodmyst Isle. Not even the blind would fail to notice the effect this is having on its creatures and the environment.$B$BYou and I will work together to stop this corruption before it spreads further.

ad5ef279f186d18ebff1a285134a21da6791b06f.comment: Razorbeak Gryphon - In Combat - Cast 'Rend Flesh' Every 14 seconds

ad5fef938a9a406c23e1690aba55369ede2e0a81.RewardText: Ah, the ears. Well done.$B$BYour service to the Alliance is unquestioned, $N. The blood you spilled in Desolace will, no doubt, save countless lives.

ad6215b1c2994556f0ff5bbe48a7b95e3807c3d3.Text: One day I'll be a real boy.

ad622aaaac8a8bb2a33f4a6d793ad0820e1e504e.Text: Enough, Michael. Business is hurting enough with this scare as it is. We can use every copper.

ad63306192fd7e091812be8139a1b0cb5069df91.comment: Flamewaker Healer - In Combat - Cast 'Shadow Shock' (Normal Dungeon)

ad655e0303abed22ca2c50b0af924198414f77cf.LogDescription: Koltira Deathweaver aboard Orgrim's Hammer wants you to go the Broken Front and defeat 5 Hulking Abominations, 5 Malefic Necromancers, and 5 Shadow Adepts.
ad655e0303abed22ca2c50b0af924198414f77cf.QuestDescription: While your commander has his focus diluted by his loathing of your Alliance rivals, you can depend on me to direct my attention squarely on the real enemy here - the Lich King and his minions.$b$bIn order to hold any hope of conquering him at the citadel, your people must take and hold each gate.$b$bFor now, let us focus on the first. Return to the front and prod their defenses. Look for any sign of weakness that we might exploit.$b$bI'll await your report, $c.

ad65760099dc9d067ba80b9aa2a284427632c298.comment: Tortured Sentinel - On Just Died - Cast Summon Hive'Ashi Drones

ad689eba3fddb23a39e2cd74d282c1c67b76fcdc.LogDescription: Grokom Deatheye at Shadowmoon Village wants you to bring him Mazakradon's Glaive and Morgroron's Glaive.
ad689eba3fddb23a39e2cd74d282c1c67b76fcdc.QuestDescription: With a larger supply of this material, I can forge a weapon suitable for you.$B$BThe two pit lords at Legion Hold, Makazradon and Morgroron, have already been equipped with these anti-demon weapons. Capturing those two weapons should provide us with enough material to make your weapon, and then some.$B$BI can't wait to bring the battle to the enemy using these weapons. That'll teach the Legion to trifle with anti-demon magics.

ad6be7d4d325cafcb3b8f35696531b168f3d03ba.LogDescription: Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers.$B$BBring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
ad6be7d4d325cafcb3b8f35696531b168f3d03ba.QuestDescription: <The head of Gan'zulah speaks.>$B$BCurse you!  And curse your ancestors!!$B$BOnly blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... do this:$B$BThrow yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east.  Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel.  Hah!  Bring me his shattered armor if you can!$B$BMay he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.

ad6c69f6479c4233b4734f0ccd0143f886135ad3.LogDescription: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.  You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
ad6c69f6479c4233b4734f0ccd0143f886135ad3.QuestDescription: It's that time of the year, $N!  The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival.  You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight.  She can tell you more about the holiday.

texts.text0_0: Pleased to make you acquaintance. May I help you?

ad6cea890114e63c7be3ca540a2a2cdd3d14ee4a.warning: Context/conditions not assigned; use only stable supported identity, never infer availability.

ad6ea7420330c556f145ea7d74037d47d078bb91.RewardText: So, you have proven strong, strong enough to best the great apes of Un'Goro--that is good. The challenge was small compared to Lar'korwi, but I will not take such a great victory away from you.$B$BThese pelts will make wonderful clothing for my tribe. You have helped me and proven worthy.$B$BBefore you set off on another task, let us give praise to the Earth Mother and thank the spirits of those apes you killed--they must know their deaths will not be wasted.

ad6ef62a193c844a41c2d9fa6b882d8ccb200c14.Text: Feel the power of the Blackrock Orcs!

ad6fbd0e559d51c1e5875ebe8906b1d15b18a863.LogDescription: Retrieve the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from Magister Hathorel.
ad6fbd0e559d51c1e5875ebe8906b1d15b18a863.QuestDescription: I've placed an enchantment on the tabard that should allow you to slip past the Sunreaver Sanctuary's defenses for a short period of time. You should have enough time to find your way into The Filthy Animal and meet up with the Sunreaver contact there, one Magister Hathorel.$B$BObtain the copy of Ancient Dragonforged Blades that his men borrowed from Wyrmrest while your disguise holds, and return it to me.

ad6fe8d900fef40a21ac475a06f556cdbe2138e2.Text: Hey!  Get away from our treasure!

ad73e929d28072a6c456721868ef43153731ff99.LogDescription: Speak with Mobu at Garrosh's Landing.
ad73e929d28072a6c456721868ef43153731ff99.QuestDescription: We need to get these tanks back up and runnin'! They ain't gonna fix themselves. Mobu's gonna be the one to handle that stuff. Talk to him and see what he needs. Maybe you can shut him up before he finally drives me into a berserker frenzy and I cleave his little gnome-sized frame in two!$B$BI hate gnomes...

ad742de2e92352ad64fd46e6a547548d93cef86d.Text: There is no escape for you.  The Crusade shall destroy all who carry the Scourge's taint.

ad74b177d7874d89e997b490a050b0a4dbab50a8.LogDescription: Search the Guest Chambers inside Karazhan for Keanna's Log and bring it to Archmage Alturus outside Karazhan.
ad74b177d7874d89e997b490a050b0a4dbab50a8.QuestDescription: Who did you say you were looking for again?  Keanna?$B$BI once met someone with that name.  She was staying up at the guest chambers.  I was supposed to keep that a secret now, wasn't I?$B$BDid you say you were with the Violet Eye?  No, I've never heard of them.$B$BI need to return to my work now, if you don't mind.$B$B<Koren seems to have forgotten about you already.>

texts.text0_0: You seek something in our fair land?
texts.text0_1: You seek something in our fair land?

ad7baa0e9d40ac8d3a86d77078e6f17803bbec37.warning: Context/conditions not assigned; use only stable supported identity, never infer availability.

ad7cd271ec05fa92743c6e9b43abe261f71a4161.Text: You will find only suffering within the realm of twilight! Enter if you dare!

ad7cea343f05ee83fd93f7c95cf2aba490d7f84b.Text: Fear not, master. I shall rend the flesh of your enemy!

texts.text0_0: The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.$B$BHe feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

ad7d255729dc70dfe048ce34e375876d5c591062.warning: Context/conditions not assigned; use only stable supported identity, never infer availability.

ad7fee346393b828ce1e7986eed714de5f8e4f92.Text: I got some extras with me; if you pay me back what I paid for them, you can have one.  I got some bait too.

ad8001509254cd284f3c004cbf8a7667ce41334e.Text: Core overload detected. System malfunction detected...

ad811a513a11c253895d8f3ca017a212e02fd90d.LogDescription: Slay 10 Bladespire Enforcers, 5 Bladespire Battlemages, 5 Bladespire Ravagers and their leader, Fingrom.
ad811a513a11c253895d8f3ca017a212e02fd90d.QuestDescription: You've proven yourself resourceful, and now I think I'm going to put you to personal use in my own fight against Gruul and his sons.$B$BThe Bladespire clan are the favored of the gronn, and while you may have thinned out their numbers elsewhere, you haven't yet dealt with their strongest.$B$BGruul protects the exterior of his lair with only the toughest of ogres, and it is those that you must kill.  Head north through the Daggermaw Canyon and you will find Gruul's Lair at the end.

ad83b7ac5f03ff00ac4f783b39b58d108b60cd8f.Text: This isn't fair!  My dearest Sully!  Come back to me!  No, $n!  Why did you bring me such news!

ad84d3a8e62290daef1dd5762f74107315ad574c.Text: What do they expect, making the bats come in at that angle? Broken necks and gamey bat stew, that's what they get.

ad870dfb81d5b4099f77d1236efab8b86db9db62.LogDescription: Waltor of Pal'ea at the Coast of Echoes in the Borean Tundra wants you to kill Kvaldir and recover 8 Tuskarr Relics.
ad870dfb81d5b4099f77d1236efab8b86db9db62.QuestDescription: Across the mist to the north you will find Garrosh's Landing. To the south are the ruins of my old home, Pal'ea. Both have been ransacked by an ancient force known as the Kvaldir.$B$BThese fearsome savages slew all of my people without mercy and drove your people inland.$B$BAll that remains of the tuskarr of Pal'ea are our personal effects, taken as relics by the Kvaldir. While we are not a vengeful race, justice must be served. The tuskarr relics must be returned to me. Enter the mist and find them...

ad89df5d3baf778bd600f359a757f4b0d0687f9a.RewardText: What? You were expecting us to have you rescue them?$B$BNow why would we do that when they have a proven track record of getting themselves captured in the first place?$B$BNorthrend is a cold place, young $N. I suggest that you adjust to it.

ad8e5606118fb0002f408d7e30483939acdb5eef.LogDescription: Use the Battery Recharging Blaster on enough Phase Hunters to get the Battery Recharge Level to 10.  Then return it to Bot-Specialist Alley at the Ruins of Enkaat in the Netherstorm.
ad8e5606118fb0002f408d7e30483939acdb5eef.QuestDescription: I have the very important task of collecting the machinery inside these ruins, but I'm having a problem keeping all of my bots charged up.$B$BThe phase hunters - those wyrm-looking things - have lots of energy!  You can find them all over the edges of this island, floating in from the nether.$B$BFill the battery on this recharging blaster by using it on a phase hunter when they're very weak, and then finish it off to soak up the last of its energy.

ad908ed263bc23b45c4c47c84776d4e0815ee6c5.LogDescription: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Ellen Stanbridge, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
ad908ed263bc23b45c4c47c84776d4e0815ee6c5.QuestDescription: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, $N. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty human in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

ad90f9f24f601f94808f92c5e26d2c0b51266ed9.Text: The ritual in Coilfang will bring Ahune through once he is fully prepared, and the resulting clash between Firelord and Frostlord will rend the foundations of this world. Our ultimate goals are in reach at last....

ad94d818e17ca1778d11057041c4667303f313f8.comment: Dreamscythe - In Combat - Cast Wing Flap

ad96ff2b1fa982f31e7070a597b7cd2303a3ed5c.RewardText: I am now able to transport you to the Molten Core. Ask and it shall be done.

ad9707f64a022e10d0e4a85b0ab966afb465b404.Text: Come one, come all.  Welcome to the Darkmoon Faire!  Don't be shy.  Step right up to Lhara and buy yourself an exotic artifact from far off lands.  If you're one of the lucky few who have found Darkmoon Cards, have a word with Professor Paleo.  Hungry?  Thirsty?  You're in luck!  Refreshments are available right here from Sylannia and Stamp.  I recommend the Darkmoon Special Reserve to wash down some Red Hot Wings.  And if the future is what you seek, then run, don't walk, to speak with Sayge.

ad993fdcc2db6a89d2934947bcf8ae6435b1d00f.Text: Please, it's not my fault! If... if I give you a refund, maybe you can speak to a healer? I don't know what you expect me to do!

ad9bce0fd49e8479b36ff1e2e84bc8d197a9d692.RewardText: I won't turn down any help! We're in the process of setting up here and trying to make the most of what we've got, until those supplies from the zeppelin arrive.

ad9c8b4717544aec464a8ed62c75e0d3f268fa39.comment: Hatefury Felsworn - Between 0-30% Health - Cast 'Enrage' (No Repeat)

ada17461165ef06f1ca7a993716db7f1c128b91f.Text: You are nothing! I answer a higher call....

ada1c106b5b638ff9b37f08880abd0cd857e1ebc.comment: Dun Garok Rifleman - In Combat CMC - Cast 'Shoot'

ada3996f497f9e82625d6b8cf8d085496a155f58.Text: You carry the taint of the Scourge.  Prepare to enter the Twisting Nether.

ada8866f1789eed7d1add0d5ed304cb19087e2e1.comment: Decrepit Necromancer - On Aggro - Cast 'Shadow Bolt' (No Repeat)

adae02fc38293407225eea64c84dae42724161d3.RewardText: So you've brought Timothy's response?$B$B<Kialon pauses a moment to read the letter, then laughs.>$B$BHe's got everything under control, he says. Doesn't need help, he says. I could've predicted that!$B$BSome people never change. Look, he even took the time to correct my spelling.$B$B<Kialon lets out a half-hearted sigh.>$B$BI shouldn't have sent the letter. I forgot. The specialist always has the situation under control. Always.

adb1dbc7418d7f85227fcbe50c7004373d1a5e2d.CompletionText: Blast it's cold today, aint it? It's like the snow never goes away, $N.$b$bYou've probably noticed already, but there are gnomes now living in our city. That's because they went and got themselves blown out of their own home. Don't go spreadin' this 'round, but I can hardly blame them--I think I woulda resorted to explosives too if Ironforge were infested with Dark Irons or the like.

adb770b76ef937d6cf6ddbf9d2c4f823dfcda971.comment: Xandivious - On reset - cast Aura of Rot

adbba6a94b9e4609de187f9fbae6a33d9b49ceb1.comment: Vengeful Geist - On Aggro - Store Target List

adc13ebbeed7b502c7b0c99d9f8a5e1e1ad589d8.RewardText: It strange because I know you put fire out, but fire still burning. Maybe this thing not so good after all, eh? Still, Moky pay you for what you do! Hopefully troll burn too!

texts.text0_1: Another new face? It's so good to meet you. I'm Dellylah.

adc62a12e18910469259b16c5d9c6032cf58199b.LogDescription: Bring Araj's Phylactery Shard to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
adc62a12e18910469259b16c5d9c6032cf58199b.QuestDescription: Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $N, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!

adcc69638b5a7d24a496d24692e69721592fb7d4.LogDescription: Arechron wants you to find Corki at Warmaul Hill.
adcc69638b5a7d24a496d24692e69721592fb7d4.QuestDescription: <Arechron shows you a grime covered letter.>$B$BI just received this letter. It's from a clan of ogres known as Warmaul that rule the northwestern lands of Nagrand. It says that they have Corki and if we don't cooperate, they're going to eat him. Admittedly, Corki is a moron, but he's still my blood. Will you rescue him, $N?$B$BI presume that he's locked up in a cage somewhere on Warmaul Hill. That should be your first stop.

adcff3f39a0939e0a551b5626b09e7f7c36c3655.LogDescription: Bring 6 Primordial Hatchlings to Dorian Drakestalker at Dorian's Outpost.
adcff3f39a0939e0a551b5626b09e7f7c36c3655.QuestDescription: We're not likely to get Broodmother Slivina's attention waving our arms around like fools, but if we're smart, we can bait her into fighting us. We'll also secure more, uh, fodder for my little project.$B$B<Dorian glances over at Zootfizzle.>$B$BBut don't worry about that for now. Just look for the primordial drake eggs in the area east and northeast of the camp. Burst them open and scoop up the hatchlings that come out. When the broodmother realizes what we've done, she'll have no choice but to face us.

addb2dcc19b486d6914c44cdcf653e831492fb51.LogDescription: Cleanse the forest of 20 Rabid Thistle Bears and return to Tharnariun Treetender in Darkshore.
addb2dcc19b486d6914c44cdcf653e831492fb51.QuestDescription: As I had feared, the cure does not work.$B$BIt saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.$B$BReturn to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, $N. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.

addea52fb8ed329b5ab8602acea6cbd50a9fc994.QuestDescription: Here's the lure.  Inside the hive network should be a crystal of some sort.  We think the silithid use the crystal as some sort of hive-wide attunement device.  As for where this crystal might be, I'd say try the hatcheries inside the hive.$B$BUsing the lure on the crystal should roust out the queen, but be warned - she will probably be protected by several guards.  Take out the queen and remove her brain.  As icky as that sounds, we desperately need to study it.  Good luck, $N!

adfa7ffdd18a11491702d460a7a3ff5228da8f70.LogDescription: Collect enough Costume Scraps from wyrmcultists to create an Overseer Disguise.  Use the disguise to attend the meeting with Kolphis Darkscale.
adfa7ffdd18a11491702d460a7a3ff5228da8f70.QuestDescription: I know what must be done!  $N, you must pose as Overseer Nuaar and attend that meeting!$B$BThe wyrmcultists at the coven all have a standard outfit that they wear, so go collect scraps from them, and when you have enough, put together a disguise.$B$BPose as Overseer Nuuar and speak with Kolphis Darkscale to see what he has to say, and then return to Tree Warden Chawn.$B$BYou'll find the coven by heading through the Wyrmskull Tunnel and following the path past the Raven's Wood and Grishnath to its end.
